## What AMPLIFY_ENGINE Does

AMPLIFY_ENGINE.py — Ready-to-post promotional content generator

AMPLIFY_ENGINE.py — Ready-to-post promotional content generator
================================================================
Generates copy/paste social media posts for every platform.
Reads active resource kits, crisis signals, and survival telegrams
to produce timely, angle-varied posts with correct character limits.

## The Numbers

- **18 functions** across 923 lines of Python
- **Reads:** amplification_posts.json, amplify_cooldown.json, resource_kits.json
- **Writes:** processed output
- **Has run() entry point:** No

## How It Fits

Every engine in SolarPunk follows the same pattern: read JSON, process, write JSON. 
No databases. No message queues. Just files and Python scripts.

AMPLIFY_ENGINE reads from amplification_posts.json, amplify_cooldown.json, resource_kits.json and writes to processed output. 
Other engines downstream pick up its output automatically.

## Try It

```bash
git clone https://github.com/meekotharaccoon-cell/meeko-nerve-center
python mycelium/AMPLIFY_ENGINE.py
```
